props.name: threshold
props.description: Weighted score, 0 to 1, at which two records are linked.

props.name: weights
props.description: How much each field counts. Only fields both records have are scored.

props.name: defaultRules
props.description: Survivorship rule per field, before any hand-picked value.

props.name: onMerge
props.description: Called when a cluster is merged.

props.name: onReject
props.description: Called when a cluster is marked as not duplicates.
